name: Alchemy
description: Gild a flower or a feather, then brew it: potions of health, ward, haste and feather. Four gold ingots around a rose, dandelion, bluebell (from Blue Flowers) or feather at the bench gild it, and a water bottle with one, two or three of the golden thing makes a weak, plain or strong potion. Health heals 3, 6 or 10 hearts at once. Ward is a set of armour in a bottle: the whole armour bar turns blue over whatever you wear, and hits wear it away before your own armour takes any wear; the bigger the potion, the longer it lasts, and a golden apple gives a strong one's too. Haste (walking and mining 20% faster) and Feather (falls hurt a third as much) last 4, 8 or 12 minutes, their bottles draining beside your figure in the inventory.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
